findings.title: Mutable default arguments
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). State leaks between calls.
findings.fix_hint: Default to None and create inside.

findings.title: Request input reaches shell command
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Command injection gives attackers code execution on the host.
findings.fix_hint: Pass an argument list with shell disabled and validate inputs.

findings.title: Secret value written to logs
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Logs are widely readable and retained, so leaked secrets spread and persist.
findings.fix_hint: Remove or mask the secret before logging.

findings.title: IDOR: client id trusted for lookup
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Any user can read or edit other users' records by changing an id.
findings.fix_hint: Scope queries by the authenticated user id or verify ownership before use.

findings.title: Client-supplied user id used as identity
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Callers can impersonate other users or escalate roles by editing the request.
findings.fix_hint: Derive identity only from the verified session or token.

findings.title: No timeout on network calls
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). A hung dependency freezes the whole service.
findings.fix_hint: Pass an explicit timeout everywhere.

findings.title: Request input reaches file path
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Path traversal lets attackers read or overwrite arbitrary files.

evidence.snippet:
def load_lines(path):
    f = open(path)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in f]
    return lines

findings.fix_hint: Resolve the path and verify it is inside the allowed directory, or use generated ids.

findings.title: Missing input validation at boundary
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Bad input reaches deep code and causes crashes or injection.
findings.fix_hint: Validate with a schema at the entry point.

findings.title: JWT signature or expiry not verified
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Attackers can forge tokens and impersonate any user.

evidence.snippet:
import jwt

def user_from_token(token):
    claims = jwt.decode(token, options={'verify_signature': False})
    return claims['sub']

findings.fix_hint: Verify signature, expiry, issuer and audience with a pinned algorithm.

findings.title: Unbounded retry loop
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). A permanent failure turns into an infinite loop that burns resources and floods logs.
findings.fix_hint: Cap attempts and total elapsed time, then surface the error.

findings.title: Unbounded in-memory queue
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). A slow consumer lets the queue grow until the process runs out of memory.
findings.fix_hint: Set a maximum size and block, drop, or shed load when it is full.

findings.title: Swallowed exception with bare pass
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Silent failures hide data loss and make incidents impossible to diagnose.
findings.fix_hint: Log with context and re-raise, or handle the specific exception deliberately.

findings.title: Shared mutable state without lock
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Unsynchronized updates lose writes and corrupt counters or caches.
findings.fix_hint: Guard shared state with a lock or use a thread-safe structure.

findings.title: Server-side request to user URL
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). SSRF reaches internal services and cloud metadata credentials.
findings.fix_hint: Allowlist destinations and block private and link-local ranges.

findings.title: Non-idempotent retryable operation
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Retries create duplicate charges, rows or emails.
findings.fix_hint: Record a unique request ID and skip work already done.

findings.title: Check-then-act race
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Concurrent actors can interleave between check and act, causing duplicates or crashes.
findings.fix_hint: Use an atomic operation, unique constraint, or lock around check and act.

findings.title: Non-atomic file overwrite
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). A crash mid-write leaves a truncated or empty file that breaks the next start.
findings.fix_hint: Write to a temp file, fsync, then os.replace onto the target.

findings.title: User input rendered as template source
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). Server-side template injection can lead to code execution.
findings.fix_hint: Keep templates static and pass user text as variables.

findings.title: Secret echoed in error message
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). Errors reach users, trackers and logs, exposing secrets.
findings.fix_hint: Strip credentials from error text and URLs before surfacing.

findings.title: Weak randomness for tokens
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Predictable tokens can be guessed or reproduced by attackers.
findings.fix_hint: Use the platform cryptographic random generator.

findings.title: Business rule duplicated in several places
findings.detail: Snap score 0.94 (candidate, not proof). Copies drift apart and produce inconsistent results.
findings.fix_hint: Move the rule into one function and call it everywhere.

findings.title: Unescaped user content in HTML
findings.detail: Snap score 0.93 (candidate, not proof). Stored or reflected XSS lets attackers act as the victim.
findings.fix_hint: Escape by default and sanitise any intentional HTML.

findings.title: Password stored with weak hashing
findings.detail: Snap score 0.92 (candidate, not proof). Leaked hashes are cracked quickly.
findings.fix_hint: Switch to argon2 or bcrypt and rehash on login.

findings.title: Batch failures dropped silently
findings.detail: Snap score 0.90 (candidate, not proof). Silent partial failure leaves data incomplete while dashboards show green.
findings.fix_hint: Collect failures, report them, and return a non-zero status when any occurred.

findings.title: Money stored as floating point
findings.detail: Snap score 0.87 (candidate, not proof). Float rounding errors accumulate into wrong totals.
findings.fix_hint: Use integer minor units or Decimal.

findings.title: Socket or connection not closed
findings.detail: Snap score 0.77 (candidate, not proof). Leaked connections exhaust server limits and ephemeral ports under load.
findings.fix_hint: Reuse a pooled client and close connections in finally or a context manager.

findings.title: Multi-step write without transaction
findings.detail: Snap score 0.76 (candidate, not proof). A crash between steps leaves orphan or half-applied records.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap writes in a transaction or use an outbox with idempotent consumers.

findings.title: No signal handler for shutdown
findings.detail: Snap score 0.99 (candidate, not proof). Abrupt kills during deploys drop in-flight work and corrupt partial state.
findings.fix_hint: Handle SIGTERM by stopping intake, draining in-flight work, then exiting.

findings.title: Retry without backoff
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Tight retries amplify load on an already failing dependency.
findings.fix_hint: Use exponential backoff with jitter and a capped delay.

findings.title: Currency missing from monetary values
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). Mixed currencies get summed or compared as if equal.
findings.fix_hint: Pair every amount with a currency code or use a Money type.

findings.title: Wall clock used for durations
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). NTP steps and DST changes make wall-clock differences negative or wrong.

evidence.snippet: if hit and time.time() - hit[0] < TTL:

findings.fix_hint: Use time.monotonic() or performance.now() for intervals.

findings.title: Database call without timeout
findings.detail: Snap score 0.98 (candidate, not proof). A stalled database can pin every worker thread and cascade into a full outage.
findings.fix_hint: Configure connect and statement timeouts on the client.

findings.title: State-changing request lacks CSRF protection
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Attacker pages can trigger actions in the victim's session.
findings.fix_hint: Require CSRF tokens or SameSite cookies and do not exempt routes casually.

findings.title: Sensitive data stored or sent unencrypted
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Interception or disk access exposes the data.
findings.fix_hint: Use TLS and encrypt sensitive fields at rest.

findings.title: Mutable module-level global state
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Hidden global state makes behavior order-dependent and tests interfere with each other.
findings.fix_hint: Move the state into an object passed in explicitly.

findings.title: Login or reset lacks rate limiting
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Attackers can brute-force credentials and codes.
findings.fix_hint: Add per-account and per-IP throttling.

findings.title: Unbounded concurrency or thread creation per item
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Thousands of workers thrash the scheduler and exhaust memory or file handles.
findings.fix_hint: Use a bounded pool or semaphore.

findings.title: File opened without close
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Leaked descriptors accumulate until the process hits its file limit.
findings.fix_hint: Use a with-block or try/finally to close the handle.

findings.title: UI or HTTP layer containing business logic
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Logic buried in handlers cannot be reused or tested without the web stack.
findings.fix_hint: Extract the logic into a service function the handler calls.

findings.title: Unbounded cache growth
findings.detail: Snap score 0.97 (candidate, not proof). Unbounded caches are a slow memory leak that ends in OOM.
findings.fix_hint: Use an LRU or TTL cache with a maximum size.

findings.title: Subprocess without timeout or status check
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). A hung child blocks forever and failed commands are treated as success.
findings.fix_hint: Pass timeout and check=True, or test the return code.

findings.title: Open redirect from request parameter
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). Open redirects power phishing and token theft.
findings.fix_hint: Allow only relative paths or an explicit host allowlist.

findings.title: Flaky sleeps instead of waiting on a condition
findings.detail: Snap score 0.96 (candidate, not proof). Slow when generous, flaky when tight.
findings.fix_hint: Wait on an event or poll with a deadline.

findings.title: Synchronized scheduling stampede
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Aligned bursts overload shared dependencies, a thundering herd.
findings.fix_hint: Add random jitter to schedules, TTLs, and reconnect delays.

findings.title: Copy-pasted blocks that drifted
findings.detail: Snap score 0.95 (candidate, not proof). Drifted copies hide bug fixes applied to only one version.
findings.fix_hint: Extract one parameterized function and delete the copies.

findings.title: Session not rotated on login
findings.detail: Snap score 0.94 (candidate, not proof). Session fixation lets an attacker pre-set a victim's session.
findings.fix_hint: Regenerate the session id on authentication and privilege change.

findings.title: Stale lock file or lock without expiry
findings.detail: Snap score 0.93 (candidate, not proof). A crashed holder blocks all future runs until manual cleanup.
findings.fix_hint: Add a TTL, release in finally, and detect stale owners.

findings.title: Batch job cannot resume
findings.detail: Snap score 0.93 (candidate, not proof). Crashes in long jobs waste hours of work and can create duplicates.
findings.fix_hint: Persist a checkpoint or make each item idempotent and skip completed ones.

findings.title: Threads or tasks never joined
findings.detail: Snap score 0.93 (candidate, not proof). Unobserved workers die silently and leak resources.
findings.fix_hint: Keep handles, join or await them, and propagate their exceptions.

findings.title: Catch-all exception handler
findings.detail: Snap score 0.92 (candidate, not proof). Broad handlers mask bugs and can swallow KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit.
findings.fix_hint: Catch the narrowest expected exception types.
